svg.text: Mortar operators D and M, dual Lagrange multipliers and the weighted gap
Segment-to-segment (mortar) coupling integrated on the slave side — thesis §4.3.3.4 (eqs. 4.19–4.31); kratos/includes/mortar_classes.h
1 · Geometry of one pair (2D): slave segment (integration side) and master segment
x¹₁ (slave node 1)
x¹₂ (slave node 2)
x²₁ (master node 1)
x²₂ (master node 2)
n (slave normal)
integration cell (clipped overlap), Gauss points ×
χ : slave → master
projection along n
Everything is integrated on the slave side Γc¹: the master shape functions are evaluated at the projected
points N²(χ(ξ)). The cell is the part of the slave segment whose projection falls inside the master (exact segmentation).
2 · Standard N_k vs dual Φ_j shape functions on the slave segment (ξ ∈ [−1, 1])
biorthogonality (thesis eq. 4.21):
∫ₑ Φⱼ N¹ₖ de = δⱼₖ ∫ₑ N¹ₖ de
Φⱼ = aⱼₖ N¹ₖ, Aₑ = Dₑ Mₑ⁻¹ (eq. 4.23–4.24)
Φ takes negative values but sums to 1; D becomes diagonal.
On distorted elements Aₑ is computed numerically per element.
code: DualLagrangeMultiplierOperators::CalculateAe
3 · Mortar operators (thesis eq. 4.29) and the weighted gap (eq. 4.31)
D[j,k] = ∫Γc¹ Φⱼ N¹ₖ dΓ · I = Σ_g w_g φ_gj N¹_gk J_g (slave–slave, DIAGONAL with dual Φ)
M[j,l] = ∫Γc¹ Φⱼ (N²ₗ ∘ χ) dΓ · I = Σ_g w_g φ_gj N²_gl J_g (slave–master, dense)
weighted gap of slave node j: g̃ⁱ_n,j = nⱼ · (D x¹ − M x²)ⱼ (WEIGHTED_GAP)
forces: f_co = B_coᵀ λ with B_co = [ 0 , −Mᵀ , Dᵀ ] on [ other , master , slave ] DoFs
sizes: D ∈ ℝ^{n_slave × n_slave}, M ∈ ℝ^{n_slave × n_master}; both stored per pair in MortarOperator
(mortar_classes.h: CalculateMortarOperators, CalculatePOperator = D⁻¹M) and linearised in
MortarOperatorWithDerivatives (ΔD, ΔM from DerivativesUtilities) for the consistent tangent
4 · From the weighted gap to the contact state (thesis eqs. 4.13, 4.41–4.44)
augmented normal pressure: λ̄_n = k λ_n + ε g̃_n (k = SCALE_FACTOR, ε = INITIAL_PENALTY)
λ̄_n < 0 ⇒ node ACTIVE (contact zone): condition assembles λ̄_n n · (D w¹ − M w²) + k g̃_n w_λ
λ̄_n ≥ 0 ⇒ node INACTIVE (gap zone): condition assembles −(k²/ε) λ_n w_λ (λ_n → 0)
penalty formulations: λ̄_n = ε g̃_n and no multiplier DoFs; frictional: λ̄_τ = k λ_τ + TANGENT_FACTOR·ε·g̃_τ
default calibration (thesis eq. 4.11): ε = k ≈ stiffness_factor · E_mean / h_mean (ALMVariablesCalculationProcess)
NCP function (eq. 4.44): C(λ_n, g̃_n) = k λ_n − max(0, k λ_n + ε g̃_n) = 0 ⇔ KKT conditions g̃_n ≥ 0, λ_n ≤ 0, λ_n g̃_n = 0
Node loop with these checks: ActiveSetUtilities (see csma_active_set_flowchart); integration: ExactMortarIntegrationUtility,
INTEGRATION_ORDER_CONTACT Gauss points per cell, CONSIDER_TESSELLATION for warped quadrilaterals.
5 · 3D pairs
Slave triangle / quadrilateral projected onto the master plane, clipped polygon → fan-triangulated cells,
each cell mapped back to the slave and to the master (thesis Figs. 4.100–4.101, App. A.2).
Dual Φ on the reference triangle: Φⱼ = 4Nⱼ − 1 (Aₑ = 4I − 11ᵀ); reference quad: Φ₁ = 4N₁ − 2N₂ + N₃ − 2N₄ (Figs. 4.16, 4.17).
Mixed pairs 3D3N4N / 3D4N3N use the slave functions for Φ and the master functions through χ.
Exact segmentation vs collocation: App. A.2.2, Figs. A.1–A.6 (Taylor patch test).
